<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 262.099 which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈261.092 Da. A formula that matches this mass within typical MS error and yields an integer double‑bond equivalent is C₁₄H₁₅NO₄ (calculated exact mass = 261.100 Da, DBE = 8). This is the most plausible molecular formula for the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H15NO4</final_answer>
